chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Chapter 109: Danyangzi’s True Body & Li Huowang’s Gut-Wrenching Rebellion
chapter_meta_description: Danyangzi is alive inside Li Huowang’s stomach. When the nuns fail to bind him, Li Huowang takes a knife to his own gut to prove he’ll never be a puppet. This is the final, bloody standoff of the Danyangzi arc.
og_title: Danyangzi Chapter: Li Huowang Pulls Out His Own Stomach in Desperate Defiance
og_description: The half-immortal Danyangzi reveals himself, but Li Huowang has a more terrifying weapon: the will to destroy himself before submitting.
twitter_title: “You said I couldn’t do anything?” — Li Huowang disembowels himself live.
twitter_description: Danyangzi lives in Li Huowang’s body. The nuns can’t stop him. So Li Huowang decides to cut the parasite out—literally. Chapter 109.
